raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Support output `logprobs` and `top_logprobs` for GPT-OSS models in `/v1/responses`, for streaming and non-streaming requests. Fixes #61629.

## Claims

- Replace the current Harmony/logprobs HTTP 400 with probabilities for visible final/commentary text, excluding generated headers, reasoning, and tool arguments.
- Keep sampled and top-token scores aligned with the original content tokens across message/channel transitions and UTF-8 boundaries.
- Preserve matching probability entries in streamed deltas, done events, and the completed response, including an unfinished UTF-8 sequence at message end.

## Validation

[Full results, logs, raw outputs, and reproduction scripts](https://github.com/Loken-Lau/vllm/tree/80cbbd0e0443547f53aecbacd0aa457a56657723) are available separately from the implementation diff.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| 2026-10-26 conflict check on upstream `d7595a76`: complete eight-file unit/parser/stream/protocol suite | 349 passed, 1 existing xfailed |
| Conflict check on the same upstream: real-model HTTP logprobs cases, A800 | 10 passed |
| After moving the fixture import: tokenizer alignment + upstream data-parallel regression cases | 17 passed |
| Initial publication branch: complete eight-file unit/parser/stream/protocol suite | 339 passed, 1 existing xfailed |
| Final publication branch: all new real-model HTTP cases, A800 | 10 passed |
| Complete Harmony integration module on the target-equivalent reviewed snapshot | 47 passed, 2 existing skipped, 1 existing non-strict xpassed |
| Qwen3-1.7B non-Harmony Responses module, A100 | 6 passed |
| Real engine scores through full/streaming conversion, plus deterministic boundaries | 30 cases pass; actual-score checks use 3 generations / 21 visible tokens |
| H200 automatic FlashAttention/FlashInfer, compilation and CUDA graphs enabled | 18 HTTP requests pass, including function round trips and 8 mixed concurrent requests |
| Incomplete-UTF8 parser regression, unchanged base / patched | 12 fail before / 12 pass after |
| Feature-disabled frozen-token conversion vs base | 9 exact matches, excluding random IDs |
| All nine changed files | Applicable pre-commit hooks pass, including Ruff, mypy and CI test selection |

The same final HTTP test on unchanged `49d634bd` fails with `400: logprobs are not supported with gpt-oss models` ([output](https://github.com/Loken-Lau/vllm/blob/80cbbd0e0443547f53aecbacd0aa457a56657723/final-review/before.log)). On the published branch, it passes with the other new HTTP cases. At initial publication, applying the patch to `49d634bd` reproduced the reviewed snapshot exactly ([original proof](https://github.com/Loken-Lau/vllm/blob/80cbbd0e0443547f53aecbacd0aa457a56657723/final-review/merge-tree-proof.json)).

The 2026-10-26 conflict fix moves the test-only `AutoTokenizer` import into its fixture, allowing the upstream `Request` import to merge cleanly. Published head `1167dba0` merges automatically with upstream; merging it with the validated `d7595a76` base produces tree `89a55a306bdfb259e06d28876c2fc1a611fff310`, identical to the local rebased validation tree after the import adjustment. Applicable pre-commit hooks also pass on the published head.

<details>
<summary>Reproduction commands</summary>

Use the Python 3.12 environment and pinned model revisions in the linked report.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_serving_responses.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_harmony_utils.py \
  tests/parser/test_harmony.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_streaming_events.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_protocol.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_errors.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_responses_utils.py \
  tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_sampling_params.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -s tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_harmony.py
# Focused real-model check after resolving conflicts:
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -s tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_harmony.py -k output_logprobs
# Fixture-import and upstream data-parallel compatibility check:
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_serving_responses.py \
  -k 'harmony_logprobs_follow_content_tokens or responses_data_parallel_rank or harmony_tool_followup_preserves_render_params'
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -s tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_basic.py
# Same regression on an unchanged base with the final test file copied in:
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -x -v -s \
  'tests/entrypoints/openai/responses/test_harmony.py::test_output_logprobs[0-False]'
```

The existing H200 Responses CI step selects the full test directory and its source dependencies cover these changes. The two skips and personality XPASS are pre-existing; no skip/xfail or numerical tolerance was added to obtain a pass. Independent requests are not required to produce bit-exact output; exact stream consistency is checked within the same generation.

</details>

A100 80GB eager serving smoke benchmark on the earlier `e2b67231` base, with the same frontend implementation: 128 generated tokens, prefix caching off, 3 warmed repeats × 8 requests at each concurrency. Values are median tok/s with the repeat range; [full timing records](https://github.com/Loken-Lau/vllm/blob/80cbbd0e0443547f53aecbacd0aa457a56657723/experiments/benchmark-summary.md) include latency and TTFT.

| Mode | Concurrency 1 | Concurrency 4 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Base, logprobs off | 36.85 (36.81–37.36) | 148.65 (148.52–148.93) |
| Patched, logprobs off | 37.80 (37.78–37.85) | 149.54 (149.03–149.91) |
| Patched, top_logprobs=3 | 37.09 (36.99–37.14) | 144.75 (143.42–144.93) |

No disabled-path regression was observed in this limited workload. Enabling probabilities costs 1.87% / 3.21% throughput versus the patched disabled path; all measured texts match their base outputs. This is not a speedup or model-accuracy claim. Probability mapping is checked against the same engine generation, rather than independently recomputing model logits. Full-card H200 validation does not substitute for MIG CI; upstream CI will run separately.

## Details

The Harmony parser optionally records content-token positions. `HarmonyContext` associates engine probabilities with visible message content, and the existing Responses formatter and streaming event builders carry those scores to the API. Raw token bytes come from the Harmony encoding so multi-token UTF-8 characters retain their original bytes.

Boundary validation also found that Harmony can finalize an unfinished UTF-8 sequence with a replacement character without emitting `last_content_delta`. The parser now emits the remaining completed-message tail before the completion segment, preserving both streamed text and buffered scores. Truncated raw bytes reconstruct the returned text when decoded with replacement.

Duplicate checks covered the issue/comments and open PR searches for `61629 in:body`, `gpt-oss Responses logprobs`, and `Harmony Responses logprob`; no matching implementation was found. Related #58018 addresses item status/zero-delta lifecycle and #59387 repairs malformed tool headers.

AI assistance (OpenAI Codex) was used for implementation and validation. A human reviewer reviewed the change and approved submission before the final audit.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

files.patch:
@@ -204,6 +204,22 @@ To get prompt token IDs before generation, use
 a self-contained Responses request without inference and returns the prompt
 token IDs, so a separate `/tokenize` call is not needed.
 
+To receive sampled-token probabilities for visible output text, include
+`message.output_text.logprobs` and optionally set `top_logprobs`:
+
+```python
+response = client.responses.create(
+    model="openai/gpt-oss-20b",
+    input="Say hello.",
+    include=["message.output_text.logprobs"],
+    top_logprobs=3,
+)
+```
+
+This is supported with GPT-OSS Harmony models for both streaming and
+non-streaming Responses. Probabilities are attached to final and commentary
+text; Harmony control tokens, reasoning, and tool-call arguments are excluded.
+
 #### Sampling parameters
 
 In addition to the OpenAI request fields, the Responses API forwards vLLM

@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@
 import importlib.util
 import json
 import logging
+import math
 import time
 from typing import Any
 
@@ -31,6 +32,185 @@
 
 MODEL_NAME = "openai/gpt-oss-20b"
 
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("top_logprobs", [0, 3])
+async def test_output_logprobs(server, stream, top_logprobs):
+    """Output-text probabilities exclude Harmony headers and reasoning tokens."""
+    async with server.get_async_client() as client:
+        response = await _collect_logprob_response(
+            client,
+            input="Say hello in Chinese in one short sentence.",
+            max_output_tokens=256,
+            top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
+            stream=stream,
+        )
+        assert response.output_text
+        _assert_text_logprobs(response, top_logprobs=top_logprobs)
+        if not stream and top_logprobs == 0:
+            baseline = await client.responses.create(
+                model=MODEL_NAME,
+                input="Say hello in Chinese in one short sentence.",
+                reasoning={"effort": "low"},
+                temperature=0,
+                max_output_tokens=256,
+            )
+            assert baseline.status == "completed"
+            assert baseline.output_text
+            assert all(
+                content.logprobs is None
+                for item in baseline.output
+                if item.type == "message"
+                for content in item.content
+            )
+
+
+def _logprob_values(logprobs):
+    return [
+        (
+            lp.token,
+            lp.logprob,
+            [(top.token, top.logprob) for top in lp.top_logprobs],
+        )
+        for lp in logprobs
+    ]
+
+
+async def _collect_logprob_response(client, *, stream, top_logprobs=3, **kwargs):
+    response = await client.responses.create(
+        model=MODEL_NAME,
+        include=["message.output_text.logprobs"],
+        top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
+        temperature=0,
+        reasoning={"effort": "low"},
+        stream=stream,
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+    if not stream:
+        return response
+
+    events = [event async for event in response]
+    assert events[-1].type in ("response.completed", "response.incomplete")
+    response = events[-1].response
+    for item in response.output:
+        if item.type != "message":
+            continue
+        for content_index, content in enumerate(item.content):
+            deltas = [
+                event
+                for event in events
+                if event.type == "response.output_text.delta"
+                and event.item_id == item.id
+                and event.content_index == content_index
+            ]
+            done = [
+                event
+                for event in events
+                if event.type == "response.output_text.done"
+                and event.item_id == item.id
+                and event.content_index == content_index
+            ]
+            assert "".join(event.delta for event in deltas) == content.text
+            if not content.text:
+                # A length limit can stop during reasoning, before any text item
+                # is streamed. The final response then has an empty text part.
+                assert content.logprobs == []
+                assert deltas == done == []
+                continue
+            assert len(done) == 1
+            assert (
+                [value for event in deltas for value in _logprob_values(event.logprobs)]
+                == _logprob_values(done[0].logprobs)
+                == _logprob_values(content.logprobs)
+            )
+    return response
+
+
+def _assert_text_logprobs(response, *, top_logprobs=3):
+    for item in response.output:
+        if item.type != "message":
+            assert "logprobs" not in item.model_dump()
+            continue
+        for content in item.content:
+            assert bool(content.logprobs) == bool(content.text)
+            assert (
+                bytes(byte for lp in content.logprobs for byte in lp.bytes).decode(
+                    "utf-8", errors="replace"
+                )
+                == content.text
+            )
+            for lp in content.logprobs:
+                assert math.isfinite(lp.logprob) and lp.logprob <= 0
+                assert len(lp.top_logprobs) == top_logprobs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("truncated", [False, True])
+async def test_output_logprobs_unicode_and_length(server, stream, truncated):
+    """Length limits and multibyte text retain consistent API probabilities."""
+    async with server.get_async_client() as client:
+        response = await _collect_logprob_response(
+            client,
+            stream=stream,
+            input=(
+                "Write a detailed story of at least 1000 words about a cat."
+                if truncated
+                else "Repeat exactly this text, with no explanation: 你好，世界！🌍🫠"
+            ),
+            max_output_tokens=16 if truncated else 256,
+        )
+    _assert_text_logprobs(response)
+    if truncated:
+        assert response.status == "incomplete"
+        assert response.incomplete_details.reason == "max_output_tokens"
+    else:
+        assert response.status == "completed"
+        assert "你好" in response.output_text
+        assert "🌍" in response.output_text
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+async def test_output_logprobs_function_round_trip(server, stream):
+    """Function arguments have no text probabilities; the final answer does."""
+    history = [{"role": "user", "content": "Get the weather at 48.85, 2.35."}]
+    async with server.get_async_client() as client:
+        response = await _collect_logprob_response(
+            client,
+            stream=stream,
+            input=history,
+            tools=[GET_WEATHER_SCHEMA],
+            tool_choice={"type": "function", "name": "get_weather"},
+            max_output_tokens=256,
+        )
+        _assert_text_logprobs(response)
+        calls = [item for item in response.output if item.type == "function_call"]
+        assert len(calls) == 1
+        assert calls[0].name == "get_weather"
+        assert set(json.loads(calls[0].arguments)) == {"latitude", "longitude"}
+        history.extend(item.model_dump() for item in response.output)
+        history.append(
+            {
+                "type": "function_call_output",
+                "call_id": calls[0].call_id,
+                "output": '{"temperature_celsius": 17}',
+            }
+        )
+        response = await _collect_logprob_response(
+            client,
+            stream=stream,
+            input=history,
+            tools=[GET_WEATHER_SCHEMA],
+            tool_choice="none",
+            max_output_tokens=256,
+        )
+    assert response.status == "completed"
+    assert "17" in response.output_text
+    _assert_text_logprobs(response)
+
+
 GET_WEATHER_SCHEMA = {
     "type": "function",
     "name": "get_weather",

         if event.type == "response.output_item.done"
     ] == args[:num_calls]
     assert [item.arguments for item in events[-1].response.output] == args[:num_calls]
+

+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def harmony_logprobs_tokenizer():
+    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+
+    return AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("openai/gpt-oss-20b")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [1, 7, 1000])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("end_token", ["<|return|>", ""])
+def test_harmony_logprobs_follow_content_tokens(
+    harmony_logprobs_tokenizer, chunk_size, end_token
+):
+    """Headers, reasoning and tool arguments must not shift output-text scores.
+
+    Single-token chunks also split UTF-8 characters over several appends.
+    """
+    encoding = get_encoding()
+
+    def convert(token_ids, logprobs):
+        return [
+            ResponseLogprob(
+                token=str(token_id),
+                logprob=logprobs[i][token_id].logprob,
+                bytes=[],
+                top_logprobs=[],
+            )
+            for i, token_id in enumerate(token_ids)
+        ]
+
+    context = HarmonyContext(
+        [],
+        [],
+        frozenset({"weather"}),
+        HarmonyParser(harmony_logprobs_tokenizer),
+        logprobs_processor=convert,
+    )
+    parts = [
+        ("<|channel|>analysis<|message|>", False),
+        ("Private thought", False),
+        ("<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>commentary<|message|>", False),
+        ("Checking the weather.", True),
+        (
+            (
+                "<|end|><|start|>assistant to=functions.weather"
+                "<|channel|>commentary<|message|>"
+            ),
+            False,
+        ),
+        ('{"city":"Paris"}', False),
+        ("<|call|>", False),
+    ]
+    final_parts = [
+        ("<|channel|>final<|message|>", False),
+        ("你好 𝄞🫠 Sunny.", True),
+        (end_token, False),
+    ]
+    expected = []
+    position = 0
+    deltas: list[ResponseLogprob] = []
+    for turn in (parts, final_parts):
+        tokens = []
+        for text, visible in turn:
+            ids = encoding.encode(text, allowed_special="all")
+            if visible:
+                expected.append(
+                    [(str(t), -float(position + i + 1)) for i, t in enumerate(ids)]
+                )
+            tokens.extend(ids)
+            position += len(ids)
+        turn_start = position - len(tokens)
+        for start in range(0, len(tokens), chunk_size):
+            ids = tokens[start : start + chunk_size]
+            finished = start + chunk_size >= len(tokens)
+            output = RequestOutput(
+                request_id="req",
+                prompt=None,
+                prompt_token_ids=[7, 8],
+                prompt_logprobs=None,
+                outputs=[
+                    CompletionOutput(
+                        index=0,
+                        text="",
+                        token_ids=ids,
+                        cumulative_logprob=None,
+                        logprobs=[
+                            {t: SampleLogprob(-float(turn_start + start + i + 1))}
+                            for i, t in enumerate(ids)
+                        ],
+                        finish_reason="stop" if finished else None,
+                    )
+                ],
+                finished=finished,
+            )
+            context.append_output(output)
+            deltas.extend(lp for group in context.last_append_logprobs for lp in group)
+        if turn is parts:
+            context.append_tool_output(
+                [OpenAIHarmonyMessage.from_role_and_content(Role.TOOL, "sunny")]
+            )
+
+    scores = [
+        [(lp.token, lp.logprob) for lp in context.message_logprobs[id(msg)]]
+        for msg in context.messages
+        if msg.recipient is None and msg.channel in ("final", "commentary")
+    ]
+    assert scores == expected
+    assert [(lp.token, lp.logprob) for lp in deltas] == [
+        item for group in expected for item in group
+    ]
+
